items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: they stopped the car and they started telling people to sit down, and you sit down, and you and you -- they were telling all the boys in the band to sit down... the boys in the band figured that maybe Toby smoked it

ctx.x: It said that both you and Toby liked practical jokes.
I think I read also, about one where somebody poured water in Braud's tuba?
